limits: The action categories were checked against original input records. A text episode or shortcut is not equivalent to a click.

Wall time includes unseparated agent, transport, observation, product and interruption costs; initial task disclosure and cold launch were not fully timed. It is not human task time or product latency.
Navigation, search, recovery and duplicated maintenance were not semantically annotated; their absence from counters is unknown, not zero.
Unknown DPI/scaling/hardware and no executed comparator prevent superiority or noninferiority claims.
Not a physical-human cognitive-load study. A single workflow does not cover the complete product.
